name: CVE-2026-128064-PoC
description: PoC of CVE-2026-128064
vuln_description:
Mixed-case HTTPS and FTPS URLs can expose data in plaintext.

The HTTP and FTP stream wrappers recognise URL schemes case-insensitively, but enable TLS only when the scheme contains a lowercase "s" at a fixed position. A URL such as HTTPS:// or FTPS:// passed to file_get_contents(), fopen() or other stream functions, or received as an HTTP redirect target, is therefore handled over unencrypted HTTP or FTP. An attacker able to observe the network traffic can read data the application expected TLS to protect, including credentials, request bodies and transferred files.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

name: frr-fixed
description: FRRouting 10.9.0-dev patched build — CVE-2026-119776 (OSPFv3 link-local address check), built and functionally tested
vuln_description:
In all prior released versions of FRRouting, the OSPFv3 (for IPv6) implementation does not check that OSPFv3 packets have a link-local source address and either a link-local destination or one of the protocol multicast destination groups.  This may enable malicious actors to establish OSPFv3 adjacencies from unexpectedly, distant IPv6 hosts. Proper usage of OSPFv3 authentication trailers (RFC 7166, as is best practice) prevents full exploitation of this issue, though may allow a malicious actor to waste CPU on authentication checks.


Note the linked PR #23935 is not sufficient to fix the issue as it only verifies the source address. It is the destination address that must be checked.


Required configuration: The OSPFv3 for IPv6 routing protocol must be running (ospf6d process) and in use (enabled globally with "router ospf6" and on specific interfaces with "ipv6 ospf6 area".)


Workaround: either:

  *  configure OSPFv3 authentication trailers ("ipv6 ospf6 authentication")
  *  or ensure through firewall co

vuln_description: soapbar is a SOAP library for Python — client, server, and WSDL handling. Prior to version 0.13.0, verify_envelope_bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken, validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify_envelope_bsp() therefore proved only that the envelope was signed by whoever supplied the embedded certificate — never that it was signed by a trusted party. An attacker who mints their own certificate, signs a forged envelope, and embeds that certificate in the token passes verification. In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

exec: Cleanup POSIX timers right after de_thread()

A per-thread CPU timer holds a reference to the PID of the thread it is
attached to and, while it is armed, its node is queued in that thread's
posix_cputimers. The task is looked up by that PID.

When a non-leader thread exec()s, de_thread() changes which task owns
that PID. pid_task(timer->it.cpu.pid, PIDTYPE_PID) then returns NULL,
but the node is still queued on tsk, which is alive. timer_lock_sighand()
takes a failed lookup to mean that the node is already dequeued, so it
has nothing to undo.

begin_new_exec() calls posix_cpu_timers_exit(me) right after
exec_task_namespaces() and that removes the leftover node, so the state
normally stays invisible. But bprm->point_of_no_return is set before
de_thread(), so if unshare_files(), set_mm_exe_file(), exec_mmap() or
exec_task_namespaces() fails, the task dies before it gets there.

name: CVE-2026-107654
description: PoC for CVE-2026-107654 — WPGuppy WordPress AJAX SQL Injection (CVSS 7.5)
vuln_description: The One to one user Chat by WPGuppy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'userId' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.6 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The plugin's permission callback is trivially bypassed because it validates a JWT that the plugin itself signs using an attacker-supplied value from the guppy_guest_account cookie, and the guest code path (userType=0) skips the get_userdata() check that would confirm the userId corresponds to a real WordPress user.

name: CVE-2026-134246
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134246 — SiYuan Missing Auth getDO API (CVSS 7.5)
vuln_description: SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.6.2 and 3.7.3 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/block/getDOMText endpoint, which renders caller-supplied DOM without checking publish access for referenced image paths. When publish authentication is disabled, anonymous visitors can submit DOM referencing a known unpublished, non-encrypted asset path to retrieve its already-cached OCR text.

name: CVE-2026-134291
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134291 — SurrealDB Filesystem Bucket Path Traversal Arbitrary File Read (CVSS 7.5)
vuln_description: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its filesystem storage bucket that only canonicalizes the bucket root, not descendant symlinks. Attackers can reference paths through a pre-existing symlink inside the bucket that pass the lexical prefix check, reading and writing files across the host filesystem.

name: CVE-2026-134325
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134325 — ArcadeDB Redis Protocol Handler Malformed Packet DoS (CVSS 7.5)
vuln_description: ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the Redis protocol handler, which neither replies to nor closes a pre-authentication connection when it receives an array whose first element is not a string. Unauthenticated attackers can resend such an array just within the 30-second socket idle timeout to hold connections open indefinitely and exhaust RedisNetworkExecutor threads.

name: CVE-2026-134367
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134367 — pypdf XFA Form Circular Reference Infinite Loop DoS (CVSS 7.5)
vuln_description: pypdf 2.4.2 before 7.0.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in its handling of XFA forms that allows attackers to cause excessive memory consumption. Attackers can supply a crafted PDF containing XFA forms with many small fields so that loading the forms consumes large amounts of memory, causing a denial of service.

name: CVE-2026-134287
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134287 — OpenRemote MQTT Authentication Bypass IoT Telemetry Injection (CVSS 7.7)
vuln_description: OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

name: CVE-2026-134393
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134393 — Frappe ERPNext Manufacturing Missing Authorization (CVSS 7.7)
vuln_description: Frappe ERPNext 10.1.41 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Manufacturing module endpoint that replaces BOMs without checking whether the caller may modify either BOM or the affected assemblies. Authenticated users who can create a BOM Update Log can send a crafted request naming two BOMs to replace the first with the second in every assembly site-wide.

name: CVE-2026-134404
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134404 — Frappe ERPNext Custom Fields Missing Authorization (CVSS 7.7)
vuln_description: Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer and supplier portal list endpoint, which returns complete selling documents and RFQs without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can request out-of-scope records to read valuation, margin, and other bidder details.

name: CVE-2026-134417
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134417 — Frappe ERPNext Purchase Missing Authorization (CVSS 7.7)
vuln_description: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns uploaded bank statement file content without checking record-level permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read full statement file contents.

name: CVE-2026-134435
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134435 — Frappe ERPNext Accounts Missing Authorization (CVSS 7.7)
vuln_description: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that records bank clearance dates, which checks only a broad role permission before writing to caller-named payment documents. Authenticated Accounts Users can send crafted requests naming payment documents of other companies, outside their User Permissions, or already submitted, to alter clearance dates and compromise bank reconciliation integrity.

name: CVE-2026-134250
description: PoC for CVE-2026-134250 — Grav CMS Form Plugin Stored XSS Admin Panel (CVSS 8.0)
vuln_description: Grav Form plugin 1.1.0 before 9.1.40 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Form::uploadFiles(), which sanitizes SVG only when a file's last extension is .svg and accepts markup under unrecognized extensions. Anonymous attackers can upload files like drawing.svg.foo through public any-type upload forms, running script in an administrator's session when opened, enabling super-admin creation on Grav 2.x with Admin2.
